At Ensono, our  Purpose is to be a relentless ally, disrupting the status quo and unleashing our clients to Do Great Things
!
 We enable our clients to achieve key business outcomes that reshape how our world runs. As an expert technology adviser and managed service provider with cross-platform certifications, Ensono empowers our clients to keep up with continuous change and embrace innovation.
We can  Do Great Things
because we have great Associates. The Ensono Core Values unify our diverse talents and are woven into how we do business. These five traits are the key to achieving our purpose:
Honesty, Reliability, Curiosity, Collaboration, and Passion.
About the role and what you'll be doing: 

As a Principal Project Manager (Consultant) in Delivery Management, you will lead complex programs and strategic client engagements across the full software development lifecycle, helping clients realize sustainable business value from technology investment and transformation.  
You will combine program delivery leadership with strong consulting capability, acting as a trusted adviser to senior and C-level client stakeholders. You will shape program vision, balance strategic, commercial, technical and delivery priorities, and bring informed challenge, alternative perspectives and relevant emerging technologies to client conversations, while building long-term relationships founded on delivery excellence, credibility and measurable outcomes.  
Within Ensono Digital, you will help define and improve delivery methodology, governance, planning, risk, financial management and tooling. You will strengthen delivery culture, develop talent, steer the Delivery Management competency towards its goals and contribute to business development and presales.  
You will be a proactive, commercially aware and influential leader who creates clarity in ambiguity, anticipates systemic challenges and mobilizes teams and stakeholders around successful outcomes.  
You will bring extensive experience of leading large, complex and strategically important program, together with the consulting mindset needed to shape client outcomes and organizational capability.   
As a Principal Project Manager you will:  
Lead complex program and interconnected workstreams, establishing clear outcomes, integrated plans, critical paths, dependencies, milestones and decision points.  
Define and evolve delivery methodologies, organizational planning standards and supporting tools, promoting sustainable delivery practices and measurable business outcomes.  
Contribute to business transformation strategies and translate strategic goals into coherent delivery models, governance arrangements and executable roadmaps.  
Influence C-level stakeholders and steering committees to shape program vision, success measures, priorities and investment decisions.  
Develop long-term client engagement strategies, leveraging your extensive delivery experience, market insight and knowledge of relevant emerging technologies to benefit the client and their goals.  
Act as a trusted adviser, balancing client strategy, delivery feasibility, technical context and commercial obligations to support successful project delivery and high-quality client outcomes.  
Define reporting and governance standards, ensuring progress, risks, issues, finances and decisions are visible, actionable and aligned to strategic outcomes.  
Implement best practice RAID management, overseeing portfolio risk, and anticipating structural threats such as budget or resourcing constraints, dependencies and other challenges before they affect delivery.  
Develop contingency strategies and escalate material risks in a way that drives clarity and constructive action without unnecessary alarm.  
Effectively manage program budgets, optimizing spend to maximize profitability and maintaining transparency over program commercials.  
Maintain broad knowledge of Ensono Digital products and services, analyze service interactions at solution-architecture level and connect client needs with appropriate Ensono specialists.  
Lead and coordinate high-quality proposals and presales responses, applying client and competitor insight, challenging assumptions and strengthening mitigations where delivery or commercial risks have not been adequately addressed.  
Contribute to the Delivery Management competency strategy and steer the team towards its goals through knowledge sharing, application of best practices and championing a culture of continuous improvement.  
Encourage professional development and lead mentoring initiatives across Delivery Management.    
Curiosity and openness to innovation: actively seeking out and experimenting with new platforms, tools, and AI-driven approaches to improve delivery efficiency, team collaboration, and client outcomes.  

We want all new Associates to succeed in their roles at Ensono. That's why we've outlined the job requirements below. To be considered for this role, it's important that you meet all Required Qualifications. If you do not meet all of the Preferred Qualifications, we still encourage you to apply.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or related discipline, or equivalent experience.  
10+ years of experience leading enterprise technology delivery programs, software development initiatives, or digital transformation engagements.  
Demonstrated experience delivering cloud transformation, application modernization, microservices, and enterprise platform initiatives.  
Strong understanding of SDLC practices, DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, release management, and operational readiness.  
Expertise in Agile as well as more traditional delivery frameworks, and a good understanding of when to leverage practices from each to benefit project delivery.  
Advanced proficiency with Azure DevOps and Atlassian products for project management. Smartsheet proficiency is desired.  
Proven ability to manage project and program budgets, financial forecasting, profitability, and commercial performance.  
Experience managing Fixed Price, Time & Materials, and Managed Services engagements.  
Strong risk management, dependency management, and governance expertise.  
Exceptional communication, facilitation, negotiation, and executive presentation skills.  
Proven ability to influence stakeholders at all organizational levels, including senior executives.  
Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with a focus on business outcomes.  
Experience leading geographically distributed and cross-functional teams.  
Demonstrated success creating collaborative team environments and driving accountability for results.  
Ability to identify opportunities for continuous improvement and implement scalable delivery practices.  
Commitment to mentorship, team development, and delivery excellence.  

Preferred Qualifications

PMI PMP, PRINCE2, SAFe, Agile, Scrum Master, or related delivery certifications.  
Experience delivering solutions on Microsoft Azure and other public cloud platforms.  
Experience within consulting, or professional services environments  
Experience supporting pre-sales activities, statement-of-work development, and solution estimation.  
Experience establishing Delivery Management Centers of Excellence or organizational delivery frameworks.  
Familiarity with AI-enabled delivery tools, automation platforms, and predictive delivery analytics.  
Experience managing global delivery programs across multiple regions and time zones.  

Why Ensono? Ensono is a place to make better happen – for our clients and for your career. You can do great things through innovation or collaboration, by learning or volunteering, or to promote diversity and inclusion. You can do great things for your own health or for a healthier planet. Whatever it means to you to do great things we want Ensono to be the place you can do it. 
We are a client-facing business, but we do encourage clients to allow us to work remotely most of the time so if you are not required to be on a client site, you can choose to work from home or in our Ensono offices.
Some of our benefits include:
Unlimited Paid Days Off
Three health plan options

new_jobs.title: Project Manager, People Mergers & Acquisitions (M&A)
new_jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

The Total Rewards Strategy & Enablement (TR S&E) team translates people strategy into business impact, building the infrastructure, programs, and systems that make Total Rewards work at scale. We bridge strategy and execution, partnering with People leadership and cross-functional teams across Finance, Legal, and the business to turn ambiguous problems into durable programs.

What you’ll do

We’re looking for a collaborative, action-oriented Project Manager to join the Total Rewards Strategy and Enablement team. In this role, you’ll lead business-critical People projects, with a primary focus on mergers and acquisitions (M&A).

Bringing an acquired business into Stripe requires coordinated work across Total Rewards, People Partners, Recruiting, People Operations, Legal, Finance, and Corporate Development. You’ll project manage the People workstream from diligence and integration planning through close and post-close execution. You’ll turn deal-specific decisions into clear plans, ownership, milestones, and risk-management approaches.

You’ll coordinate functional owners across People workstreams, establish plans and dependencies, and step into the work when needed to unblock progress or close critical gaps. Your work will support transaction timelines, reduce business disruption, and create a consistent experience for acquired Stripes.

You’ll build People M&A’s capabilities through repeatable playbooks, infrastructure, and cross-training. This individual contributor role is well suited to someone who can bring structure to ambiguity and move between strategy and execution.

Responsibilities

Project manage People M&A workstreams from diligence and planning through close and post-close execution. Workstreams may include organizational alignment, employee data, onboarding, recruiting, and people program integration.
Serve as a central coordination point across Total Rewards, People Partners, People Operations, People Systems, Recruiting, People Support, Corporate Development, Legal, Finance, and Corporate Technology.
Align plans, dependencies, decisions, and accountability with transaction timelines.
Develop and run integration and change-management plans that give functional leads, acquired Stripes, and other affected audiences the information and support they need at each stage of a transaction.
Identify cross-functional dependencies, risks, and blockers early. Coordinate resolution and escalate issues when needed to protect integration timelines and the Stripe experience.
Establish feedback and support mechanisms for acquired Stripes, including surveys, office hours, and centralized support channels. Use feedback to improve integration plans and change-management approaches.
Build and improve People M&A’s infrastructure, including project plans, templates, checklists, playbooks, reporting, and retrospective documentation.
Build capability across People workstreams through documentation, cross-training, and shared practices that support more consistent future integrations.
Support other business-critical and transformational projects across Total Rewards and the People team as needed.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements

You have 7+ years of project or program management experience at a global company, including 2+ years project managing workstreams within the M&A lifecycle, including diligence, integration planning, close readiness, and post-close integration.
You have experience leading complex, cross-functional programs from planning through execution and building repeatable program infrastructure, such as integration playbooks, project-plan templates, readiness checklists, risk logs, or retrospective processes.
You have a track record of turning ambiguous problems into structured, repeatable programs. You’re comfortable building new programs in a scaling environment while improving and standardizing how work gets done.
You have excellent written and verbal communication skills. You can write a one-page executive update, a decision memo tailored to stakeholders, and a step-by-step operator playbook with equal fluency. You guide project teams through complex work in a direct, approachable, and inclusive way.
You can manage senior cross-functional stakeholders across Total Rewards, People Partners, People Systems, Recruiting, Corporate Development, Legal, and Finance. You know when to build alignment, raise a risk, and escalate.
You’re comfortable working with data and systems such as Workday and Greenhouse. You use data to clarify decisions, communicate recommendations, and define requirements with People Systems partners.
You focus on the experience of acquired Stripes and the teams operating the program, not only on program artifacts.
You can manage competing priorities and adapt in a fast-paced environment. You work effectively independently and across teams, bring structure to complexity, and follow through on the details that make a program successful.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with change management frameworks, such as the Prosci ADKAR Model, and applying them to employee or operational change.
Project or program management certification or training, such as Project Management Professional (PMP), Lean, Six Sigma, or a comparable methodology

Hybrid work at Stripe

This role is available either in an office or a remote location (35+ miles or 56+ km from a Stripe office).

In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This hits a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility about how to do this in a way that makes sense for individuals and their teams.

Working remotely at Stripe

A remote location is defined as being 35 miles (56 kilometers) or more from one of our offices. While you would be welcome to come into the office for team/business meetings, on-sites, meet-ups, and events, our expectation is you would regularly work from home rather than a Stripe office. Stripe does not cover the cost of relocating to a remote location. We encourage you to apply for roles that match the location where you currently live or plan to live.

Pay and benefits

The annual US base salary range for this role is $127,600 - $191,400. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the US may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

Additional benefits for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; 401(k) plan; medical, dental, and vision benefits; and wellness stipends.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

Apply now

new_jobs.description:
Overview Of Position

The Senior Real Estate & Facilities Analyst supports the Global Corporate Real Estate organization by transforming complex portfolio, financial, occupancy, lease, project, facilities, workplace, sustainability, and employee data into accurate reporting, actionable insights, and decision-support materials.

This role combines advanced analytics, data governance, business intelligence, technology enablement, and practical artificial intelligence capabilities with strong corporate real estate knowledge. The analyst develops dashboards, scorecards, forecasts, scenario models, business cases, and executive presentations that support portfolio optimization, workplace strategy, capital investment, lease decisions, operational improvement, and long-term planning.

The successful candidate is detail-oriented, technically capable, and able to communicate complex findings clearly to executive, financial, operational, and technical audiences while partnering effectively across functions and with external service providers.

What will be my duties and responsibilities in this job?

Data Analytics, Governance & Portfolio Analysis (25%)

Collect, cleanse, reconcile, validate, manipulate, and analyze structured and unstructured data from multiple internal and external systems.
Maintain data standards, definitions, ownership, validation procedures, business rules, quality controls, and documentation across Corporate Real Estate data sources.
Monitor data quality, identify discrepancies and root causes, and coordinate remediation with internal teams and external service providers.
Analyze occupancy cost, utilization, lease activity, facilities operations, capital projects, sustainability, workplace experience, employee work arrangements, and portfolio risk.
Develop key performance indicators, benchmarks, forecasts, trends, scenario models, and ad hoc analyses to support portfolio optimization, site consolidation, workplace strategy, lease decisions, and capital investment.

Business Intelligence, Reporting & Technology (25%)

Build, manage, and continuously enhance centralized dashboards, scorecards, reporting tools, and analytical platforms for site-level and consolidated portfolio reporting.
Translate business requirements into scalable data, reporting, visualization, and technology solutions using advanced Excel and business-intelligence tools.
Automate recurring data collection, validation, analysis, and reporting to reduce manual effort and improve the speed, consistency, and reliability of insights.
Support system integrations, data pipelines, interfaces, data warehousing, application programming interfaces, and connections between source systems and reporting platforms.
Maintain recurring Real Estate & Facilities metrics, balanced scorecards, capital budgeting, fixed-asset reporting, and operational reporting as required.

Artificial Intelligence & Innovation (20%)

Serve as a Corporate Real Estate resource for artificial intelligence, generative AI, intelligent automation, and emerging analytical technologies.
Identify, prioritize, test, and implement practical AI use cases for document analysis, lease abstraction, portfolio research, forecasting, data-quality monitoring, executive reporting, and employee-service delivery.
Partner with Technology, Information Security, Legal, Risk, and Data Governance teams to support responsible and policy-compliant AI adoption.
Develop user guidance, demonstrations, training materials, and adoption support while maintaining awareness of developments in AI, analytics, commercial real estate technology, and workplace intelligence.

Executive Reporting & Decision Support (20%)

Convert complex data and analysis into clear, concise business recommendations, dashboards, scorecards, business cases, and executive presentations.
Communicate portfolio performance, risks, trends, opportunities, business impact, and recommended actions through effective data visualization and storytelling.
Tailor reporting for executive, operational, financial, and technical audiences and support annual planning, quarterly reviews, leadership meetings, and strategic initiatives.

Stakeholder & Program Support (10%)

Partner with Real Estate, Facilities, Finance, Procurement, Human Resources, Technology, Risk, Sustainability, Security, and regional teams to define business questions, reporting requirements, and priorities.
Coordinate cross-functional analytics and technology initiatives, including plans, milestones, dependencies, risks, deliverables, adoption, and performance measures.
Maintain productive relationships with service providers, technology vendors, consultants, and data partners; support continuous improvement and other analyses identified by leadership.

What are the requirements needed for this position?

Education

Bachelor’s degree in data analytics, business analytics, information systems, computer science, finance, real estate, business administration, engineering, or a related field.

Professional Experience

Five or more years of progressive experience in data analytics, business intelligence, data governance, technology, corporate real estate, finance, or a related discipline.
Experience developing complex analyses, dashboards, reports, data-quality processes, or technology-enabled solutions using information from multiple systems.

Knowledge And Skills

Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including complex formulas, PivotTables, Power Query, data modeling, scenario analysis, charts, and large-dataset manipulation.
Experience developing dashboards and visualizations using Power BI, Tableau, or a comparable business-intelligence platform.
Understanding of data governance, data quality, master data, business definitions, controls, validation, and ownership.
Professional experience using artificial intelligence or generative AI tools and an understanding of responsible-use considerations.
Strong analytical, organizational, project-management, problem-solving, written, verbal, presentation, and executive-communication skills.
Ability to translate technical or analytical findings into clear business recommendations, manage multiple priorities independently, and collaborate across functions and organizational levels.

What other skills/experience would be helpful to have?

Masters degree in a relevant field.

Professional Experience

Experience supporting a geographically dispersed corporate real estate portfolio or working within a Fortune 500 company.
Knowledge of portfolio strategy, transactions, lease administration, occupancy planning, facilities management, capital projects, workplace experience, sustainability, financial modeling, forecasting, benchmarking, and scenario planning.
Experience with integrated workplace management systems, lease-administration platforms, facility-management systems, occupancy technologies, or corporate real estate databases.
Experience working with outsourced service providers, technology vendors, consultants, and cross-functional global teams.

Knowledge And Skills

Working knowledge of SQL, Python, DAX, data warehouses, cloud platforms, application programming interfaces, or data-integration tools.
Experience with Microsoft Power Platform, including Power BI, Power Automate, Power Apps, or Copilot.
Experience implementing AI-enabled workflows, large language models, intelligent automation, or predictive analytics.
Intermediate or advanced Microsoft PowerPoint skills and strong data-visualization and storytelling capabilities.
Relevant certification in analytics, data governance, artificial intelligence, project management, Power BI, or commercial real estate.

Job Summary

The Information Security Analyst II supports and strengthens the university’s information security program by implementing, monitoring, and improving controls that protect institutional data, systems, and infrastructure. This role administers security configurations, investigates threats and incidents, conducts risk-based access reviews, and ensures alignment with applicable regulatory requirements and security standards. The analyst collaborates across IT and academic units to integrate security best practices into daily operations, communicates security requirements to technical and non-technical audiences, and supports ongoing security awareness and continuous improvement.

FGCU is building a culture of curiosity, commitment and collaboration. We value employees who successfully work with others and drive positive change through critical thinking and decisive action. If you thrive in an environment of innovation, accountability and mutual respect, you will find a good home here.

At Florida Gulf Coast University, employees are expected to work on campus as part of a collaborative, mission-driven environment. While this role does not directly interact with students, its on-site presence is essential to supporting the university’s operations and advancing student learning across the institution.

Job Description

Typical duties include but are not limited to:

Administers and maintains identity and access management (IAM) controls, including roles, permission sets, query and report access, component interfaces, and automated process groups, in alignment with least-privilege principles.
Designs and maintains security items such as roles, permission lists, query and report access, component interfaces, and batch process groups.
Detects, investigates, and resolves security events, policy violations, and anomalous activity; documents findings and escalates incidents in accordance with the university’s incident response procedures.
Identifies, reports, and resolves security violations.
Manages user provisioning and de-provisioning workflows, evaluates access requests against established role definitions, and troubleshoots authentication and authorization issues across enterprise platforms.
Administers security aspects for users, identifies appropriate security accesses, and troubleshoots security and access issues.
Partners with IT and academic units to assess security risks, drive process improvements, and ensure that security controls are effectively integrated into operational workflows and project delivery.
Collaborates with users to maintain and improve information security processes and procedures.
Maintains accurate security documentation, including asset records, acceptable use guidance, network security standards, and evidence artifacts required for audit and compliance purposes.
Maintains records, forms, and documents the proper use of the network.
Tracks and manages security-related work requests, incidents, and projects using the IT service management (ITSM) platform, ensuring timely resolution and accurate reporting.
Completes tracking in the work order system.
Conducts periodic access certification reviews and user entitlement audits to verify compliance with established security standards, FERPA, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and other applicable regulatory requirements.
Conducts access review audits to ensure compliance with established security standards and policy guidelines.
Designs and implements data protection controls, including encryption, data loss prevention (DLP) configurations, and secure data handling procedures to reduce exposure from unauthorized access or exfiltration.
Develops new techniques and procedures to protect data from unauthorized users.
Continuously evaluates security processes and tool effectiveness; develops recommendations for control improvements and promotes adoption of current security frameworks and industry best practices.
Reviews processes, evaluates results, recommends new processes, and promotes best practices.
Identifies capability gaps in the university’s security posture, develops business cases for security investments, and leads or contributes to implementation projects that advance institutional security objectives.
Identifies the need for functionalities that enhance the organization's security posture and manages projects to implement these enhancements.

Other Duties

Performs other job-related duties as assigned.

Additional Job Description

Required Qualifications:

This position requires either seven years of directly related full-time experience or, as an alternative, a Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution in computer science, business administration, or related field and three years of full-time experience directly related to the job functions.
Professional full-time experience working with wide and local area networks, business applications development and support, systems security, or related experience.
Any appropriate combination of relevant education, experience, and/or certifications may be considered.

Preferred Qualifications

Three years full time professional experience working with wide and local area networks or business applications development and support.
Security specific certifications such as GIAC, CEH, or CISSP.
Experience working with CIS Critical Controls or NIST 800 series documents.
Experience working in Higher Education.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

Proven ability to think strategically and approach challenges with creativity.
Demonstrated track record of reliability, meeting goals, and holding oneself accountable.
Strong interpersonal skills and experience working effectively across teams.
Knowledge of security strategies (operating system hardening, vulnerability management, change management, application testing/patching, security tools, and software products).Knowledge of modern security domains including endpoint and OS hardening, vulnerability and patch management, identity and access management, cloud security, application security testing, and security tooling (SIEM, EDR, DLP, IDS/IPS).
Knowledge of network/system security access, management, and testing.
Knowledge of network and system security principles, including segmentation, access control architectures, zero trust concepts, and security testing methodologies.
Knowledge of applicable security policies, best practices, and principles.
Knowledge of standard computer logging processes and understanding of the types of events logged.
Skill in identifying complex problems and reviewing related information to develop and evaluate options and implement solutions.

Who We Are

Vident Advisory serves as a valued partner to asset managers and sponsors, offering portfolio management, trading, operational, and capital markets expertise across indexed and active strategies. We support ETFs, UCITS, mutual funds, SMAs, hedge funds, and other vehicles across global equity, fixed income, currency, commodity, and alternative markets, including strategies that utilize derivative instruments. Our platform enables clients to efficiently launch, operate, and scale investment strategies across multiple jurisdictions.

What You’ll Do

This role sits in the day-to-day fund operations function, supporting a wide range of asset classes and strategies with a strong emphasis on accurate, timely trade processing and settlement. Buy-side funds operations experience preferred. The Senior Portfolio Operations Analyst
is responsible for ensuring the integrity of daily data, accurate and timely post-trade booking, smooth settlement and reconciliation processes, margin/collateral management, and effective support to internal and external stakeholders across time zones. The role requires a solid understanding of investment operations across multiple asset classes and the systems that support them and takes on a greater degree of independent ownership and problem-solving than an entry-level analyst position. The position requires close collaboration within the team and across the organization, emphasizing teamwork, adaptability, and proactive communication.

Key Responsibilities

Start-of-Day (SOD) Controls and Data Validation
Perform daily SOD checks on pricing, reference data, curves, corporate actions, and other inputs supporting portfolios across asset classes.
Monitor automated data pipelines, investigate breaks or missing data, and re-run or escalate processes as needed to ensure accurate downstream reporting and valuation.

Trade Execution, Booking, and Cash Activity (Bloomberg AIM or comparable platform)
Oversee daily trade executions, matching, and booking of T+1 activity into the portfolio/accounting system, including creations/redemptions (cash and in-kind), custody FX trades, distributions, fees, and miscellaneous cash entries.
Ensure accurate reflection of position and cash impacts across systems and coordinate with custodians and fund accountants on discrepancies.

Margin, Collateral, and Corporate Actions
Manage daily margin calls and instruct associated collateral movements as needed.
Monitor corporate actions, submit elections and instructions as required, and verify post-event position and cash outcomes.

Reconciliations and Settlements
Perform daily position and cash reconciliations between internal systems, custodians, and fund accounting records.
Investigate and resolve reconciliation breaks related to pricing, accruals, FX, timing, or booking issues.
Support timely settlement of trades, following up on failed or delayed settlements with brokers and custodians.

Brokerage & Custodial Relationships
Maintain existing brokerage and custodial relationships and assist with new account onboardings.

Ongoing Operational Support
Assist with month-end and period-end processes, NAV support, portfolio reporting, and audit or regulatory data requests.
Help maintain and build technology to support investment trading and portfolio management, and contribute to process improvements, documentation, and control enhancements as product complexity grows.

Who You Are

M.B.A./Bachelor's degree in finance (or related major) required.
5+ years of experience in the investment management industry with a focus on nvestment operations across multiple asset classes, portfolio support, fund accounting, or middle/back office functions.
Candidates must be analytical, detail-oriented, and precise with numbers, with a solid understanding of securities/fund industry investment concepts and strategies, and the ability to trace data and cash flows across multiple systems.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and comfort working with operational data and reconciliations.
Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with internal teams and external counterparties across different time zones.
Experience with Bloomberg AIM or other portfolio and fund accounting platforms (e.g., SimCorp, Geneva, Advent, SS&C).

new_jobs.description:
Senior Data Analyst

Why join Housr?

We’re building Housr

to make life easier for students living off campus, from finding somewhere to live to accessing the services, offers and experiences around them.
We’ve reached $10m ARR and raised a $10m Series A to support our growth. As we expand across the UK and North America, we’re looking for a Senior Data Analyst to help us make better use of the data across our business.

The opportunity

We collect useful data across our product, sales, marketing and operations. The next step is turning more of it into clear answers that help teams decide what to do.
You’ll own analysis across the business, build reporting that people can use themselves, and investigate the questions that need a closer look. That could mean understanding why one student cohort is more engaged than another, where people drop out of a journey, or how acquisition costs compare with the value customers bring.
This is a hands-on individual contributor role, with regular contact across the business and leadership team, and has room to shape how we work with data.

Why this role is interesting

Our current setup includes MySQL, HubSpot, Google Analytics and Metabase. Some analysis can happen within those systems today; joining information across them still involves manual work.
We’re planning a more connected data platform. You’ll help define the questions it needs to answer, the metrics we should agree on and the reporting teams need, working with engineering and external specialists on the wider build. There’s plenty of useful analysis to get into while that work develops.

new_jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

The Total Rewards Strategy & Enablement (TR S&E) team translates people strategy into business impact, building the infrastructure, programs, and systems that make Total Rewards work at scale. We bridge strategy and execution, partnering with People leadership and cross-functional teams across Finance, Legal, and the business to turn ambiguous problems into durable programs.

What you’ll do

We’re looking for a collaborative, action-oriented Project Manager to join the Total Rewards Strategy and Enablement team. In this role, you’ll lead business-critical People projects, with a primary focus on mergers and acquisitions (M&A).

Bringing an acquired business into Stripe requires coordinated work across Total Rewards, People Partners, Recruiting, People Operations, Legal, Finance, and Corporate Development. You’ll project manage the People workstream from diligence and integration planning through close and post-close execution. You’ll turn deal-specific decisions into clear plans, ownership, milestones, and risk-management approaches.

You’ll coordinate functional owners across People workstreams, establish plans and dependencies, and step into the work when needed to unblock progress or close critical gaps. Your work will support transaction timelines, reduce business disruption, and create a consistent experience for acquired Stripes.

You’ll build People M&A’s capabilities through repeatable playbooks, infrastructure, and cross-training. This individual contributor role is well suited to someone who can bring structure to ambiguity and move between strategy and execution.

Responsibilities

Project manage People M&A workstreams from diligence and planning through close and post-close execution. Workstreams may include organizational alignment, employee data, onboarding, recruiting, and people program integration.
Serve as a central coordination point across Total Rewards, People Partners, People Operations, People Systems, Recruiting, People Support, Corporate Development, Legal, Finance, and Corporate Technology.
Align plans, dependencies, decisions, and accountability with transaction timelines.
Develop and run integration and change-management plans that give functional leads, acquired Stripes, and other affected audiences the information and support they need at each stage of a transaction.
Identify cross-functional dependencies, risks, and blockers early. Coordinate resolution and escalate issues when needed to protect integration timelines and the Stripe experience.
Establish feedback and support mechanisms for acquired Stripes, including surveys, office hours, and centralized support channels. Use feedback to improve integration plans and change-management approaches.
Build and improve People M&A’s infrastructure, including project plans, templates, checklists, playbooks, reporting, and retrospective documentation.
Build capability across People workstreams through documentation, cross-training, and shared practices that support more consistent future integrations.
Support other business-critical and transformational projects across Total Rewards and the People team as needed.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements

You have 7+ years of project or program management experience at a global company, including 2+ years project managing workstreams within the M&A lifecycle, including diligence, integration planning, close readiness, and post-close integration.
You have experience leading complex, cross-functional programs from planning through execution and building repeatable program infrastructure, such as integration playbooks, project-plan templates, readiness checklists, risk logs, or retrospective processes.
You have a track record of turning ambiguous problems into structured, repeatable programs. You’re comfortable building new programs in a scaling environment while improving and standardizing how work gets done.
You have excellent written and verbal communication skills. You can write a one-page executive update, a decision memo tailored to stakeholders, and a step-by-step operator playbook with equal fluency. You guide project teams through complex work in a direct, approachable, and inclusive way.
You can manage senior cross-functional stakeholders across Total Rewards, People Partners, People Systems, Recruiting, Corporate Development, Legal, and Finance. You know when to build alignment, raise a risk, and escalate.
You’re comfortable working with data and systems such as Workday and Greenhouse. You use data to clarify decisions, communicate recommendations, and define requirements with People Systems partners.
You focus on the experience of acquired Stripes and the teams operating the program, not only on program artifacts.
You can manage competing priorities and adapt in a fast-paced environment. You work effectively independently and across teams, bring structure to complexity, and follow through on the details that make a program successful.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with change management frameworks, such as the Prosci ADKAR Model, and applying them to employee or operational change.
Project or program management certification or training, such as Project Management Professional (PMP), Lean, Six Sigma, or a comparable methodology

Hybrid work at Stripe

This role is available either in an office or a remote location (35+ miles or 56+ km from a Stripe office).

In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This hits a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility about how to do this in a way that makes sense for individuals and their teams.

Working remotely at Stripe

A remote location is defined as being 35 miles (56 kilometers) or more from one of our offices. While you would be welcome to come into the office for team/business meetings, on-sites, meet-ups, and events, our expectation is you would regularly work from home rather than a Stripe office. Stripe does not cover the cost of relocating to a remote location. We encourage you to apply for roles that match the location where you currently live or plan to live.

Pay and benefits

The annual US base salary range for this role is $127,600 - $191,400. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the US may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

Additional benefits for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; 401(k) plan; medical, dental, and vision benefits; and wellness stipends.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

Apply now

About the role

Apellix is hiring a Drone LMS Project Manager (Apellix Academy Manager) to own the online training program every new operator must pass before their drone leaves our warehouse.

Apellix builds semi-autonomous drones for power washing, soft washing, spray painting, coatings and NDT inspection. Our drones are 100% U.S.-made, NDAA-compliant, U.S. Army-certified, and flying in 21 countries.

You will run Apellix Academy end to end: building new modules, keeping existing ones current as our products and software change, enrolling and tracking learners, and making sure every buyer is ready for hands-on training. This is a role for someone who has already built drone training content inside an LMS and wants to own a program, not just contribute to one.

What you'll do

Build new content

Design and produce new Academy modules for each platform (B2, Blue, SPD, SPD Blue, NDT).
Write scripts, storyboards, quizzes and assessments; shoot and edit video, screen recordings and walkthroughs with our engineering and production teams.
Turn technical material from engineers into clear, practical lessons for non-aviator operators.

Maintain and improve the program

Edit and update existing modules whenever hardware, firmware, software or procedures change, and retire outdated content.
Use completion rates, quiz results and trainer feedback to find where learners struggle, then fix those lessons.
Keep Academy content aligned with hands-on training in Jacksonville and on-site trainer visits.
Coordinate with partner-delivered content, such as our "how to clean" course, so learners get one consistent experience.

Run the LMS

Administer the LMS: enroll buyers and operators, set up courses and learning paths, manage roles, permissions and certificates.
Track each learner's progress and confirm Academy completion, since no drone ships until the pilot completes the Academy and hands-on training.
Answer learner questions and nudge buyers who stall so they can schedule hands-on training sooner.
Report regularly on enrollments, completion times and pass rates.

Grow the Academy

Recommend new courses, certifications or tiers (e.g., refresher, advanced, or international versions) that improve operator results.
Help evaluate LMS tools and integrations, including connections to our customer portal.

Required qualifications

FAA Part 107 License.
Drone training content built in an LMS (required).
You have designed, produced and published drone or UAS training courses on an LMS such as TalentLMS, Thinkific, LearnDash, Docebo, Moodle or similar. Please share samples or links.
3+ years in instructional design, e-learning development or technical training.
Hands-on LMS administration: enrollments, learning paths, assessments, certificates and reporting.
Comfort with authoring and media tools to produce video, interactive and quiz content yourself.
Ability to learn complex hardware and software quickly and explain it plainly to people new to industrial drones.
Strong writing and organization; you can run a program with minimal oversight.

Nice to have

Experience with industrial, commercial or enterprise drone platforms (spraying, cleaning, inspection) rather than only consumer drones.
Background in the power washing, coatings or field-services trades.
Experience training a customer base (not just employees), including international learners; Spanish a plus.

Benefits

Federal holidays
401(k) and company contributions
Paid healthcare with Telehealth and counseling

send your resume and links to at least two drone training modules or courses you built in an LMS.

new_jobs.description:
Company Description

Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.

Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.

Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.

As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.

For everyone, everywhere.

Job Description

More about our mission
and what we offer
.

We're looking for an Implementation Manager to join our fast-growing Finance & Treasury Product team in London or Tallinn. This is a unique opportunity to have an impact on Wise's mission by making sure our customers' money stays safe as we launch new products and expand into new markets.

Your mission

Wise customers trust us to keep their money safe. Safeguarding is how we make sure that every penny we hold for customers is protected, in every country we operate in.

Today we run safeguarding across 11 legal entities and client asset protection (CASS) across 6. That means more than 500 bank accounts in scope, 5+ external audits a year, regular internal audit and regulator reviews, and several new legal entities launching every year.

As Wise grows, so does our Safeguarding team. Our global team builds and runs the automated controls and tools that every entity relies on, while regional teams own what happens locally. As the Implementation Manager, you'll connect the two. You'll make sure new products and entities are onboarded into our controls properly, and that incidents are handled quickly and transparently.

You'll work closely with the Safeguarding Product Manager, Safeguarding Engineering and Analytics, Treasury and Regulatory Product Compliance, Finance, Payment and Treasury Operations, and regional controllers around the world.

How You'll Contribute To Our Mission

New product reviews, onboarding and approval

Run the safeguarding review and approval process for new products and product changes, making sure every step is followed and nothing launches without the right controls in place.
Follow up with product teams, Treasury Regulatory Product Compliance and Finance to keep projects moving.
Keep a clear, up-to-date tracker of projects that need safeguarding support, and report on their status.

New entity launches

Support new legal entities as they launch, working out how they'll be onboarded into our global systems and controls.
Define how controls need to be set up locally for each entity, for example safeguarding timings.
Work with Regional Finance and Compliance so that local controllers are ready to take ownership from day one.

Execution and implementation

Plan and lead the work to integrate new Wise products into our safeguarding systems, together with product managers, engineers, data analysts and operations specialists.
Own large, complex integrations from start to finish, and support the team with clear documentation: requirements, project plans, resourcing, testing and delivery.

Support

Keep documentation of product flows and safeguarding calculations up to date.
Get hands-on when things go wrong: help product and engineering teams understand the impact of an incident, drive it to resolution, and improve controls so it doesn't happen again.

Qualifications

A bit about you

You know regulated finance. You have experience in implementation, controls, regulatory operations or treasury operations in financial services or fintech, and you're used to working alongside Compliance to launch things the right way.
You understand how customer money is protected. You know safeguarding, client money/CASS or a similar framework for protecting customer funds. If you know one regime well and are keen to learn others, that works too.
You enjoy getting deep into the processing logic. You're comfortable with reconciliations, ledgers and financial data. You like to understand in depth how money flows through a product and what it depends on, and you can explain what a reconciliation break means and why it matters.
You create clarity. You bring people together behind a common goal, balance different points of view and bring structure to complex problems. You write clearly, and you can explain complex concepts in simple terms to engineers, compliance specialists, finance teams and senior stakeholders without losing the nuance.
You get it done. You keep many workstreams moving across teams and time zones without losing track of the details. You hold others to account without being their line manager, and you follow things through to the end.
You stay calm when things go wrong. You make sound calls during incidents, and you know when to escalate.

Some Extra Skills That Are Great (but Not Essential)

Experience supporting external or internal audits, or regulator inspections.
Experience with control frameworks, obligation-to-control mapping or risk tools.
Working knowledge of SQL or data tools (e.g. Looker, Snowflake) for investigating issues yourself.
Experience launching a new regulated entity or a new market.
Familiarity with safeguarding rules in more than one region (UK, EU, APAC, North America).

Additional Information

For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.

We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.

Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.

Über Mettler Toledo
METTLER TOLEDO ist ein weltweit führender Anbieter von Präzisionsinstrumenten undDienstleistungen. In Labor-, Prozessanalytik-, Industrie-, Produktinspektions- undEinzelhandelsanwendungen sind wir bekannt für Innovation und Qualität. Unser Vertriebs-und Servicenetzwerk zählt zu den umfangreichsten der Branche. Unsere Produkte werden inmehr als 140 Ländern verkauft, und wir sind unmittelbar in ca. 40 Ländern präsent. WeitereInformationen finden Sie unter www.mt.com.

Ihre Aufgaben
Du siehst Dich mittelfristig in einer Führungsrolle?

Bringe Dein Talent und Deine bereits gesammelte Berufserfahrung in unser international ausgerichtetes Programm ein. Mit einem individuellen Trainingsangebot und umfassenden Mentoring-Angeboten entwickelst Du Dich zu einem der Top Leader bei METTLER TOLEDO. Werde Teil unseres internationalen Junior Management Programms und starte bei uns als Business Developer (m/w/d) / Product Management Business Analyst (m/w/d).

Innerhalb der ersten drei Jahre durchläufst Du drei unterschiedliche Stationen. Darüber hinaus lernst Du unsere spannenden, interkulturellen und innovativen Standorte in Greifensee - Schweiz und Columbus, Ohio -USA kennen. Anschliessend wartet eine spannende Position mit Führungsverantwortung für ein Team oder ein Projekt auf Dich.

Stage 1: Expertise / Netzwerk auf- und ausbauen
Am Standort Greifensee steigst Du ein in der Business Area Service im Bereich des Produktmanagements inkl. Preisgestaltung, Entwickeln und Einführen von neuen Dienstleistungsprodukten, Business Analysen zur Strategie- und Unternehmensentwicklung sowie Umsetzung von Marketing- und Verkaufskampagnen. Dabei rapportierst Du direkt an den Head of Business Area Service. Deine Aufgaben im Detail:

* Umsetzung und Optimierung der Preisgestaltung sowie deren Transformation/Interpretation ins Business.
* Unterstützung der Strategie- und Unternehmensentwicklung (Business Development).
* Durchführung von Datenanalysen zur Planung und Umsetzung von Verbesserungsinitiativen (Data Analytics).
* Planung und Umsetzung von Marketing- und Verkaufs-Kampagnen in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Marketing und Service Sales.
* Entwicklung / Einführung neuer Dienstleistungsprodukte (Business Analyse & Umsetzung).
* Mitarbeit in und Durchführung von Projekten innerhalb der Service Organisation Schweiz.

Stage 2: Auslandseinsatz

* Nach ca. 2 Jahren versenden wir Dich ins Ausland: Columbus,Ohio - USA.
* Für 12-18 Monate bist Du in einer unserer Schwestergesellschaften in dem oben genannten Standort tätig.

Stage 3: Erste Führungsrolle

* Nach drei Jahren im Programm übernimmst Du bereits Führungsverantwortung für ein Team oder ein Projekt innerhalb unserer Organisation als ersten Schritt Deiner Karriere im Management.

Ihr Profil
* Hohe Motivation und der Wille, sich zur Führungskraft weiterzuentwickeln in Kombination mit ausgeprägter Service- und Kundenorientierung. • Fähigkeiten im Bereich 'Data Analytics' und eine Affinität für Zahlen und Analysen (data driven approach).
* Ausbildung: Diplom- oder Master-Abschluss mit Vertiefung in Betriebsökonomie, Management etc. oder mit naturwissenschaftlicher Vertiefung wie bspw. Biologie, Chemie, Physik gepaart mit betriebsökonomischen Erfahrungen.
* Auslandserfahrung: Erste Auslandserfahrung in Form eines Auslandssemesters/ Praktikums, beruflichen Auslandseinsatzes / Expatriate oder Berufserfahrungen in einem internationalen Unternehmen.
* Berufserfahrung: Erste Erfahrung in der Management-Beratung oder im Bereich Service, Business Development, Geschäftsfeldentwicklung o.ä. eines industriellen Unternehmens.
* Sprachen: Fliessende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (mind. B2-Niveau), Kenntnisse einer weiteren Sprache von Vorteil.

Unser Angebot
* Unbefristete Festanstellung im Rahmen des Leadership Programs, das in eine Führungsrolle bei METTLER TOLEDO, einem hervorragend aufgestellten Global-Player, mündet
* Steile Lernkurve durch vielseitige Projekt-Assignments und intensive Trainings- und Mentoring-Angebote
* Aufbau eines weltweiten Netzwerks
* Auslandseinsatz an einem METTLER TOLEDO Standort den USA.
* Attraktives und planungssicheres Vergütungspaket
* Flexible Arbeitszeiten + hybrides Arbeitsmodell
* 40 Stunden Woche mit mindestens 25 Tagen Ferien plus 4 - 7 Brückentage im Jahr
* Gratisparkplätze und ein Arbeitsplatz mit direkter ÖV-Anbindung.
* Personalrestaurant
* Weitere attraktive Zusatzleistungen wie diverse Kostenbeteiligungen an sportliche Aktivitäten.

Wir unterstützen Dich bei einer grossartigen Gelegenheit, Deine erste Führungsrolle zu übernehmen und Deine Stärken in einem internationalen Arbeitsumfeld zu entwickeln.

Nutze bitte zum Hochladen Deiner Bewerbung unser Onlineportal. Für Fragen steht Dir Maren Miksch-Rühl (maren.miksch-ruehl@mt.com) gerne zur Verfügung.

new_jobs.description:
Overview

Every moment of every day, people all over the world turn to Panasonic to make their lives simpler, more enjoyable, more productive and more secure. Since our founding almost a century ago, we’ve been committed to improving peoples’ lives and making the world a better place–one customer, one business, one innovative leap at a time. Come join our journey!

Responsibilities

IT Project Manager- Infrastructure/ Security

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0tMgKm_71qs

( by clicking this link you are being referred to an external site that is not part of Panasonic )

Meet the Recruiter:
Amber Smallwood

What You'll Get To Do

We are seeking an experienced IT Project Manager to lead and support a portfolio of enterprise infrastructure, cybersecurity, cloud, network, data center, and business technology transformation initiatives. The ideal candidate will possess a strong background in project management, IT infrastructure, and information security programs, with a proven ability to successfully deliver complex, cross-functional projects from initiation through deployment and operational transition.

This role will partner closely with Infrastructure, Information Security, Enterprise Architecture, Network Operations, Cloud Engineering, End User Services, business stakeholders, external vendors, and executive leadership to ensure the successful execution of strategic technology initiatives.

The successful candidate will report directly to the IT Project Manager- Infrastructure/ Security
and will operate in a remote environment while leading geographically dispersed project teams, vendors, and stakeholders. The role requires strong leadership, communication, risk management, and governance capabilities, along with the ability to drive alignment across technical and business organizations.

Candidates with prior experience leading large-scale infrastructure deployments, IT Security programs, cloud transformation initiatives, network and data center projects, IT operational improvements, technology modernization efforts, and PMO governance activities are highly desired. Experience working within regulated environments and managing projects involving security, compliance, business continuity, and disaster recovery requirements is a plus.

Business Relationship / IT Project Management

Foster strong partnerships with customers, stakeholders, and sponsors.
Develop and maintain project plans, schedules, budgets, resource forecasts, and status reporting.
Lead project execution through all phases of the project lifecycle, including initiation, planning, execution, monitoring, and closure.
Partner with technical leads, architects, cybersecurity professionals, and service owners to establish delivery plans, manage dependencies, coordinate technical reviews, and ensure required architecture, security, and operational approvals are completed.
Ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and within budget.
Facilitate project governance, steering committee meetings, and executive status reviews.

IT Governance

Ensure that all organizational governance, compliance, security, and change control needs are met.
Provide weekly reports to organizational and Sponsor management highlighting issues and escalations needed.
Support testing, cutover planning, deployment readiness, and stabilization activities.

Stakeholder Management

Build strong relationships with business leaders, IT teams, consultants, and vendors.
Provide clear, concise communication to project teams and executive stakeholders.
Facilitate decision-making and drive issue resolution.
Manage stakeholder expectations and project communications.

Risk, Financial & Resource Management

Identify project risks, issues, assumptions, and dependencies.
Develop mitigation and contingency plans.
Track project financials, forecasts, budgets, and resource allocations.
Monitor project performance using established PMO methodologies and governance standards.

Change Management & Adoption

Partner with business stakeholders to support organizational change management activities.
Coordinate training, communications, and transition planning.
Assist with business readiness efforts to ensure successful adoption of new processes and systems.

Qualifications

What You'll Bring:

Education & Experience

Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.
8+ years of progressive IT experience, with exposure to enterprise infrastructure, cybersecurity, cloud services, network, data center, endpoint, or related technology environments.
Minimum of 5 years of project management experience delivering enterprise infrastructure, IT Security, cloud, network, data center, or end-user technology initiatives.
Experience in a broad scope of IT technologies including cloud-based solutions such as IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS.
Strong understanding of project management methodologies including Waterfall, Agile, and hybrid approaches.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience supporting infrastructure separation, integration, consolidation, or migration activities associated with mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, organizational restructuring, or site transitions.
Previous PMO, portfolio management, or governance experience.
PMP will be considered a primary preferred project management certification with Agile/Scrum as secondary certification.
Experience with ServiceNow SPM, Microsoft Project, Smartsheet, or similar project management tools.

Desired Candidate Profile

The Ideal Candidate Will Bring a Blend Of

Strong project management discipline and leadership.
Ability to influence and persuade business management in the areas of developing sound and practical IT solutions.
Executive presence and the ability to influence across all organizational levels.
Proven success delivering large-scale business and technology transformation initiatives.
Ability to work independently in a highly collaborative remote environment.

Success Measures

In this role, the IT Project Manager will be expected to:

Maintain project schedules, financials, and governance artifacts with high accuracy.
Proactively identify and mitigate project risks.
Provide clear executive-level reporting and communication.
Enable successful business adoption of implemented solutions.
Contribute to PMO governance, best practices, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Benefits & Perks - What's In It For You

Panasonic prioritizes total well-being and offers comprehensive benefits options to support physical, emotional, financial, social, and environmental health:

Health Benefits – Offering medical, dental, vision, prescription plans, plus Health Savings Account and Flexible Spending Account options.
Voluntary Benefits – Life, accident, critical illness, disability, legal, identity theft, and pet insurance.
Panasonic Retirement Savings & Investment Plan (PRSIP) – 401(k) plan with company matching contributions and immediate vesting.
Paid Time-Off Benefits – Vacation, holidays, personal days, sick leave, volunteer, and parental & caregiver leave.
Educational Assistance – Tuition reimbursement for job-related courses after six months of service.
Health Management and Wellbeing Programs –Lifestyle Spending Account, EAP, virtual health management, chronic condition, neurodiversity, tobacco cessation, substance abuse support, and life stage and fertility resources. Available to eligible employees starting the first day of the month following your start date. Eligibility for each benefit may vary based on employment status, location, and length of service.
Employee Recognition Program - High5 employee recognition and awards platform, quarterly and annual employee recognition
Annual Bonus Program - Opportunity for an annual performance-based bonus.

We Take Opportunity Seriously

At Panasonic, we are committed to a workplace that genuinely fosters inclusion and belonging. Fairness and Honesty have been part of our core values for more than 100 years and we are proud of our diverse culture as an equal opportunity employer.

The wage range of $140,000 - $150,000 is just one component of Panasonic’s total package. Actual compensation varies depending on the individual’s knowledge, skills, experience, and location. This role may be eligible for discretionary bonuses and incentives.

We understand that your career search may look different than others and embrace the professional, personal, educational, and volunteer opportunities through which people gain experience. If you are actively looking or starting to explore new opportunities, send us your application!

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or other characteristic protected by law. All qualified individuals are required to perform the essential functions of the job with or without reasonable accommodation.

Due to the high volume of responses, we will only be able to respond to candidates of interest. All candidates must have valid authorization to work in the U.S.

Thank you for your interest in Panasonic.
